notes.title: Devlog#4
notes.content:
Hi!

Devlog is a little bit late, but I have good and bad news for you.

Let’s start from bad ones.

Our energy supplier assumed that we need a vacation, a rustic one kind without an electricity, so lately we have regular outages.

The second issue is the engine. It turned out to be so good, that I got into a creative frenzy and my translator got something with her eyes, when she saw the amount of text to be translated. 

Before I prepare all graphics, handle with all sounds and music effects and polish everything… Well, It’ll take time. 

Now good news!

The electricity is back and outages occur only during nights! So, we are doing our best.

Because the engine turned out to be just magical and casting spells on robot works just fine I have created so much of plot that I have no idea how much the game has grown. It will turn out when all preparations are ready. 

The last good news is that after version 2.0 we already have a sketch of version 3.0 (no idea how long 3.0 version will be…) and all for the same price. 

The inspiration is priceless and I hope you will like the effects of it. 

The price for the game will stay the same, so we want to thank everyone who already supported us and left a sign, new dreamers are always welcome!

Take care and look for (I hope more often) updates!

PS. Did anyone REALLY finish the game and find the true ending of 1.0 version?

notes.title: Devlog#3
notes.content:
Hello!

Beta tests of already announced 2.0 version will take place the next week!

Right after tests are finished start looking for the next devlog with a release date.

Then we will officially announce what can be found in the update.

To make the longing nicer we are informing about a discount that will be available to the next week. 

See you soon!

notes.title: Devlog#2
notes.content:
Hello!

We would like to announce that for February we have already started preparing a quite huge storyline update for our Dream!

For now, we can only tell that it will be a new storyline, which will allow you to get familiar with the story from a new perspective and will give answers for at least a part of questions. 

Further info will be publicized on regular basis on Steam devlog and X.

See you!

notes.title: Devlog#1
notes.content:
Hello Dreamers!

We know that it is a ‘kind of strange :E’ to create the first part of a devlog, when the game is already released, but it turn out on its own, so  xD

Sorry for the late introduction, because of some personal issues we were not able to greet you earlier.

But today is the day!

We are ONImations – small indie games’ (2 – literally two people) creators group. We are focused on games with rich, deep and appealing histories with more than one ambiguous protagonist, point of view and possible path.

Dream of a Nightmarish Runaway is our very first piece. We are planning further development of this game and we will share road-map with you soon :)

For now, thank all of you who already supported us!

For all of you, see you soon in the Dream!

ONImations

notes.title: Dream of a Nightmarish Runaway 1.41
notes.content:
Hello Dreamers!

Christmas is coming! So ONImations decided to release the first bigger update whitch will
contain polish localization, and something more :).

Dream of a Nightmarish Runaway update 1.41 is coming on 12/24/2024!

What you can find there:
Polish localization.
Mac support.
Gallery of achievements.
Brand new logo.
New font for every language.
New trailer.
New screenshots.
A few suprises to be found.
A few minor bug fixes.

Have fun and see you soon!

ONImations
